title: Breast core needle biopsy
text:
SURGICAL PATHOLOGY

Specimen: Left breast, 2 o'clock 3 cmFN, US-guided core needle biopsy (14G x 5)
Clinical: BI-RADS 4C mass, 1.4 cm.

Gross: Five cores, 1.0-1.6 cm, entirely submitted.

Diagnosis:
Breast, left, 2 o'clock, core needle biopsy:
  INVASIVE CARCINOMA OF NO SPECIAL TYPE (ductal), Nottingham histologic grade 2 (tubules 3, nuclei 2, mitoses 1).
  - Ductal carcinoma in situ, cribriform type, intermediate nuclear grade, present.
  - Lymphovascular invasion: not identified.

Immunohistochemistry: ER positive (90%, strong), PR positive (40%, moderate), HER2 1+ (negative), Ki-67 15%.

Radiologic-pathologic concordance: concordant.
teaches: Synthetic breast biopsy: compare pathology follow-up suggestions with the rules.
